description: Cursor-native primitives layered on top of the universal skills/entrypoint: a glob-scoped .mdc rule for Inbox conventions (default install) and an owner-opt-in .cursorignore read-restriction template generated from restricted-tagged paths.
standards_gap: Glob-scoped .cursor/rules/*.mdc activation and .cursorignore access exclusion are Cursor-only mechanisms; AGENTS.md and the Agent Skills standard cannot express per-directory rule scoping or path-based read exclusion.

artifacts.notes: Copy verbatim. An existing foreign file at the target is never overwritten - report and skip. Idempotent: re-copy only when the manifest-recorded hash drifts.

install.generator_semantics: Owner-opt-in only: default overlay installation skips this artifact entirely; install it only when the owner explicitly chooses harness-level read restriction. When selected: seed the target from the template if absent. On every sync, rewrite the managed block between the '# BEGIN second-brain restricted/private (generated)' and '# END' markers wholesale with one line per path printed by the generator command — idempotent, handles both gained and lost tags, and never touches owner lines outside the markers. Re-run whenever notes gain or lose the restricted/private tag; the file does not regenerate itself, and a stale file under-excludes.

reverse.condition: only when the machine manifest records this overlay as the file's creator; a pre-existing user .cursorignore is user-owned

artifacts.notes: Owner-selected read restriction, not the restricted/private tag's enforcement layer (see 00_Meta/CONVENTIONS.md, restricted/private). Path-based, Cursor-specific, and incomplete. See the Restricted content section of ../wiring.md - the wiring doc is authoritative for the generation step.
